claim: Drawing number PT9L-F01 is assigned to two distinct physical items: the outer carton drawing (F0164, Part name: 外箱, doc K040100014357620814-图纸-PT9L-F01+V1.0.pdf) and the product appearance drawing (F0177, Part name: 外观图, doc PT9L-外观图-v1.0-20240627.pdf). Both documents carry identical Drawing NO. PT9L-F01 in their title blocks, creating an unresolvable document-control ambiguity in the design output package.
reason: Both evidence items DMR-068 and DMR-138 are verified and excluded_from_primary_scope=false, meaning both are active controlled documents within the same DHF design output package (设计输出清单二). DMR-068 confirms F0164 title block: Drawing NO. = PT9L-F01, Part name = 外箱. DMR-138 confirms F0177 title block: Drawing NO. = PT9L-F01, Part name = 外观图. The annotation in F0177 itself flags the collision (⚠️ 与外箱 PT9L-F01 同号但不同件), indicating the conflict was recognized but not resolved at document issuance. Under ISO 13485 design output control requirements, each drawing number must uniquely identify a single controlled item; having two distinct parts share the same drawing number violates document uniqueness and traceability requirements. The evidence is sufficient and direct — no additional context is needed to confirm this finding.
